description: This file defines a RecyclerView Adapter for displaying and managing items in a shopping cart within an Android application. It manages UI elements for cart items, including increasing, decreasing, and removing items.

classes.name: CartAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView.Adapter subclass for displaying cart items with controls for quantity adjustments and removal.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Updates the adapter with a new list of CartItem objects and refreshes the display.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the layout for a cart item and creates a ViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data from a CartItem to the ViewHolder.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the cart.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a CartItem to the ViewHolder views, setting text and click listeners.
